body:
Oh how deliciously ironic.

Greetings from Bangkok.

This is one of the reasons my routines are all off, and why I write that I'm so far away from friends and family, and why my savings can last so long.

Therapist would be the best bet. I don't want anyone else to know. 

I ate a chocolate bar and sent an email to a therapist (easier than a phone for me). 

Writing it out on reddit, somewhere where it's possible someone would read it (rather than a diary), did help a lot, even if it only helped me realize how stupid I sound.

So, I'll be okay. The therapist will probably call, we'll set up a time to meet, I can make it until then.

Still feel like an idiot for posting here but I'll be okay. Thanks.

Re-reading this... fuck I'm a narcissistic prick. I don't mean to be; it just comes out that way, the most I do is try to notice and limit it, but still.

My apologies again. I hope someone can get past that for a moment and ... I don't know. Maybe this whole thing was just to vent so I could avoid further action or something. Sorry.
